This is the Oleen Hospital that Napoleon told us about.
This is Oleen Hospital.
Could this be the "SNATCHER Maintenance Facility" that Gibson described?
I'll open the door. Are you ready?
Yeah! Go ahead!
There is a neon sign on the roof of the building. The entrance appears to be at the front.
It really has the atmosphere of an illicit hospital.
I wonder what they specialize in? There are no signs or anything.
That's because it's one of the illicit places.
There are no notices or anything. It can't be a legitimate operation.
The lights are on, and there are signs of people inside. It looks like they are open.
It appears that they are open.
It's away from the worst of the slums, but you could hardly call this a nice neighborhood.
Illegally parked cars are nearly blocking the streets.
The cars don't appear to be abandoned.
If they're not scrap, then what? The patient's cars?
There are some nice luxury cars in the bunch. Must be the patients' vehicles.
It says "Hospital Oleen".
What? So this is Oleen Hospital...
Is this really the place we are looking for?
It's an automatically opening double-door.
The lobby can be seen. It looks rather warm inside.
Strange cries can be heard coming from the building.
All the windows and other openings have heavy metal screens covering them.
It is covered with heavy metal screening.
We should be able to learn much more from the inside.
There is no one in the area. This hospital is in quite a lonely neighborhood.
Animal droppings can be seen in several places on the road and sidewalks.
The neon sign appears different from the one in Little John's memory...
Is this really the hospital that we saw in Little John's memory?
This is odd. They seem to be using pressure-plate sensors rather than more modern infra-red.
In other words, things haven't changed much since they opened. Must have been here a while.
It's not locked. If we approach it, it will open.
It doesn't smell like a hospital usually does. It's more like the smell of...filth.
We can't know unless we go in. Gillian, be very careful.
It really smells...
Yes. It rather smells like animals.
My olfactory sensors can't discern what it is.
Why don't we do that after we've finished checking out the place?
Let's use the videophone later, okay?
Gillian! What good does it do to come this far if you're just going to leave?
We have to find out what this hospital is all about!
Let's talk to some of the people at the hospital.
Why don't we show the image from Little John's memory to some of these people?
...let's find the reception area.
There are a number of animals here. Let's check some of the others.
Let's take a little better look at the animals here.
Let's take a look at the animals here.
We're in the hospital. This would appear to be the reception area.
This room seems to be a waiting area.
It appears to be a smaller establishment than I thought.
Hmm? Everybody is holding an animal of some sort.
Everybody here has a small animal of some kind with them. They must be very rich individuals.
A receptionist is doing some paperwork behind the counter.
Looks like they take insurance here.
Then it cannot be an illicit hospital.
The receptionist appears to be doing paperwork related to treatment.
That appears to be one of those "Super-memory Parrots". People use these birds frequently now when they study foreign languages, or have other sounds they want to record.
It keeps saying the same thing. Maybe its memory chip is damaged.
It's a Magellanic Kobe Penguin. They were developed in '33 as a breed which could thrive in tropical and temperate climates.
Look. Even in temperatures like this it is full of energy and jumping around.
That's one of those "humming dogs", you know, the ones that have had their larynxes modified to help eliminate sound pollution.
Then why did it bark?
That's probably why it is at the hospital.
As you can see, it is a very quiet animal.
That's probably why it is at the hospital.

Ah yes, that's one of those "pocket pets," popular among women as a combination pet and handbag. They were created by splicing marsupial genes into common household animals. This one would appear to be one of the cat models.
It seems to have a wound in its pouch. That happens frequently with those, I'm afraid.
Women's sharp cosmetics cases end up hurting the inside of the animals' pouches.
Those poor animals... Women just won't let anything stand between them and their pursuit of beauty...
...and you wonder why you have trouble getting along with women...
The reception area is just inside the entrance on the front side of the building.
It appears that the treatment area is behind here.
Everyone is carrying an ID. It would appear that they are all law-abiding Neo Kobe citizens.
There are no suspicious looking types here.
Their animals all have collars and ID tags. They appear to be pets.
The sign says "Dangerous or hard-to-control animals must be on a leash or in a cage".
There are numerous posters about pet insurance and vaccinations.
Good Morning! Good Morning! Good Morning!
I really wish he would shut up.
I really wish he would shut up!
I really wish he would shut up!
I really wish he would shut up!
What? ...A.T.D.?
It's short for 'Antique Trendy Drama'. Dramas that were popular in the previous century are being rerun.
Oh spare me!
...Jeez, what kind of drama was he watching?
Have you heard any rumors about SNATCHERS in this area?
I'm not worried. We keep a dog at our house. So does this hospital. SNATCHERS hate dogs, right?
There is no solid proof, but animals with good senses of smell are said to be able to pick them out.
That's right! That's why so many people are starting to keep pets these days.
SNATCHERS? Do those things really exist?
We'll be okay, won't we? They stay away from animals, right?
Excuse me. Do you know anything about an 'OLEEN' hospital?
'OLEEN'? This is Oleen Hospital... Is that not it?
...'OLEEN'? That's not here.
Hmm... isn't that some other hospital?
What kind of a hospital is this?
What? Didn't you know before you came? This is an animal hospital! Sorry, but I don't think they can help your little robot friend.
Hey! I'm not sick! I'm functioning properly.
The doctor here has a really good reputation. It's so hard to find a good vet these days...
Well, they don't do direct genetic manipulation, but their treatments are really good. They service manufactured pets here, too.
And they're approved by the Life Manipulators Oversight Committee.
What about the doctor here? Is he any good?
He's a fully licensed doctor with his genetic manipulation permit. This is about the only place in town that will see you without an appointment.
Fully licensed, eh?
He really loves animals, you know. And he's a great surgeon!
Whew! It really smells in here!
Whoa! What a smell!
That's the odor given off by these animals and their by-products.
So that's it. I thought something was ripe...
It's a form of pollution.
Are you a police officer?
Has something happened?
What's this? New "Pet Gum"?
Something wrong with this?
I'm looking for a hospital with this sign.
Well, it's not the one for this place. Looks kinda' similar, though.
Hmm. It looks similar, but I don't think it's the same.
Isn't that a different hospital?
I really don't care for animals.
Please, Gillian. I have real trouble with animals.
I'm really sorry, but I just can't deal with animals at all.
Was the sign in the memory written in the alphabet?
The sign in Little John's memory is written in a totally different style.
That's your Junker ID. It gives you all your special privileges. Take good care of it.
That's the expense money that the agency gave you.
That's the chess piece that Gibson had which he used to identify the name of Queens Hospital.
That's the chess piece that Gibson had.
That's the visual image that was recovered from Little John's memory.
That's the photograph that was hidden in the Chief's office.
That's the picture of a temple that was on the wall at Queens Hospital.
It has an IC chip built-in which contains all of your personal data.
In principle, you are allowed to charge the Agency for as much money as is necessary for your investigation.
This chess piece was being used to signal the name of Queens Hospital.
That's a wooden chess piece. I believe it's the one which goes next to the King.
It's a picture of the neon sign at Queens Hospital.
It appears to read "Oleen Hospital". It's no doubt the neon sign to some hospital.
This is a photograph of Red Square in Moscow before the Catastrophe.
This is St. Basil's Cathedral. It's a famous cathedral that was in Moscow before the Catastrophe.

We've boarded the turbocycle. Where would you like to go?
Let's head back and check out Headquarters one more time.
Let's stop by my apartment on the way.
Let's head there after a stop at Alton Plaza.
All right, setting course for Queens Hospital.
Gillian! Where are you going? Aren't we going to head for Queens Hospital?
Chickening out at this point won't do you any good!!
Let's head for the SNATCHER'S base!
Gillian, we don't have time for that. We should head straight for Queens hospital.
We've had it! There's nothing we can do!!
Don't give up so easy! There might be some way out of this yet.
What in the world are you doing?
We're finished! It's been nice knowing you, Gillian...
Shut up! There must be something...
It's hopeless. We're moving at over 200 kph. There's no way we can survive.
Damn! The speed keeps increasing!
We're going to die! We're going to die!!
We've had it. Oh dear lord...
That's it, Gillian! Prayer! Look! A new command has appeared on the menu!
That won't work any more.
No good! The door is locked!
You can't be serious! At this speed you'd be torn to pieces!
We'd never survive it! It would be like jumping off the Brooklyn Bridge!
That's a rather dated image, don't you think?
What? Are you giving up??
Oh no! Gillian has given up! Now we're truly doomed!!
Oh shut up, will you... I'll think of something... probably.
Metal, pull that lever over there!
All right, here goes...
...it broke off.
I guess we have had it...
I've got it! We'll try sideswiping the cliff! Hang on Metal!
All right! Into the cliff one more time!
Yaaaah!
Damn! Even that won't stop it!
All right, I'll try plowing this thing into the sandpile over here! Hang on tight!
Okay, let's try hitting the sand bank one more time. C'mon baby!!
Eeeeyaaah!!
Damn! Won't anything work?
All right, let's try a long shot. I'll push this button here!
You've turned the radio on Gillian! What are you doing??
All right, I'll try another button!
Oh no! That was the switch for the afterburner!
Whoops!
You've boosted our thrust by 23%! Do something, Gillian!!
How about this button?
That's the heater! Temperature increasing...68 degrees, 69...70...71...72. There! It's reached a comfortable room temperature!
I don't care about the temperature right now!
Well Metal, I haven't known you for very long, but it's been fun.
Gillian...
Let's pray together.
...actually, I'm not that religious.
I didn't think so.
Save me! If you save me I promise I'll worship you devoutly! You can pick the religion!!
Do you really mean that Gillian?
...of course not!
